newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Times Publishing in leisure venture.
newsitem.headline: Times Publishing in leisure venture.

text.p: Times Publishing Ltd said on Wednesday it had agreed to set up a joint venture company to distribute entertainment and educational software.
It said in a statement its subsidiary, Times The Bookshop Pte Ltd, signed a memorandum of understanding with Roadshow Entertainment Asia Pte Ltd to set up a private-listed company.
The joint venture has an authorised share capital of Singapore $5 million and a paid-up capital of S$1.2 million.
Each firm will hold a 50 percent stake in the paid-up capital of the company and Times Publishing said the investment by Times The Bookshop would be financed from internal sources.
